== Title ==
<span lang="ja">遅延連鎖</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">3フォース使用して場の相手の側に配備する。相手のタイはすべて配備コスト＋1となる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">皇帝の強大な殺人兵器は、あらゆる段階で微妙な調整を必要としている。どこかの行程で思わぬ手違いが起これば、配備計画全体が大幅に遅れる事態を招きかねない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Logistical Delay]].

'''Lore''' — The Emperor's mighty killing weapon needs fine adjustment at every stage. An unexpected slip in any step can greatly delay the whole deployment plan.

'''Game text''' — Use 3 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of the table. All of the opponent's TIEs are deploy cost +1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is 遅延連鎖 (delay chain). Lore speaks of the Emperor's killing weapon and a delayed deployment plan, not the Empire's military machine and supply delays. Game text matches the English TIE deploy +1 effect.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-logisticaldelay.gif|Original English face]], [[Logistical Delay]].</ref>
